items.title: MRF Q4 Results: Profit rises 37% YoY to Rs 680 crore; co declares Rs 229 per share dividend
items.description: MRF Q4 Results:  Tyre maker MRF announced strong financial results.  Net profit surged 37% year-on-year to Rs 680 crore in the fourth quarter.  Revenue from operations also saw a 14% increase.  For the full financial year, MRF reported an 11% growth in revenue and a 29% rise in annual net profit.  The company's board recommended a final dividend of Rs 229 per share.

items.title: CarTrade Tech Q4 Results: Net profit surges 54% YoY to Rs 65 crore, shares rally 8%
items.description: CarTrade Tech reported a 54% year-on-year jump in Q4FY26 consolidated net profit to Rs 64.6 crore, while revenue from operations rose nearly 20% to Rs 203.1 crore. The strong earnings performance lifted the company’s shares by 8%.

items.title: BSE Q4 Results: Cons PAT jumps 61% YoY to Rs 797 crore, revenue soars 85%; Rs 10/share dividend announced
items.description: India's oldest exchange, BSE, reported a significant 61% surge in its consolidated net profit, reaching Rs 797 crore for the March-ended quarter. This impressive growth was accompanied by an 85% revenue increase, with the company posting Rs 1,564 crore in Q4FY26 compared to Rs 847 crore in the prior year period.

items.title: Dabur Q4 Results: Cons PAT rises 15% YoY to Rs 369 crore, revenue up 7%; Rs 5.50 per share dividend announced
items.description: Dabur India reported robust fourth-quarter earnings growth driven by strong domestic FMCG demand, healthy volume expansion and broad-based category performance. The company announced a final dividend while highlighting resilience amid global inflationary pressures and geopolitical challenges affecting international business operations during the quarter.

items.title: Suryoday Small Finance Bank reports Q4 profit at Rs 49 crore
items.description: Suryoday Small Finance Bank reported a strong turnaround in fourth-quarter earnings with improved profitability and higher operating profit. The lender also recorded annual profit growth while reducing its gross non-performing assets ratio, reflecting better asset quality and improved financial performance during the year.

items.title: Kennametal India Q3 revenue jumps 39% to Rs 403 crore, net profit doubles to Rs 51 crore
items.description: Kennametal India reported sharp growth in quarterly revenue and profit, supported by strong demand for hard metal products and volume expansion. Rising raw material costs increased expenses, while the company highlighted supply chain management efforts and announced an interim dividend for shareholders.
